meta.name: commit-and-pr
meta.description: Creates Arena-conformant commits and pull requests. Enforces DCO sign-off (git commit -s), no AI attribution lines (no Co-Authored-By, no Generated-with-Claude footers), <username>/<type>/<short-description> branch naming, separate new commits rather than --amend when iterating on PR feedback, and main as the default base branch. Use when the user asks to commit, stage changes, push the current branch, open a pull request, make a PR, submit changes, or mark work as ready to merge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范地创建提交和拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望自动遵循团队的 Git 提交和 PR 约定
copy.tagline_en: Create standardized commits and pull requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically follow team conventions for Git commits and PRs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会按照Arena贡献者指南帮你创建提交和拉取请求：提交时强制包含DCO签名，使用指定的分支命名格式，禁止AI归属行；迭代反馈时添加新提交而非修改历史；PR标题和正文有格式要求；目标分支默认为main。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、暂存更改、推送分支、创建拉取请求或标记工作为可合并时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些更改提交并推送到远程。
say.note: Claude会执行提交并推送，遵循DCO和分支命名规范。

say.text: 创建一个拉取请求到main分支。
say.note: Claude会推送当前分支并打开PR，标题和正文符合格式。

say.text: 按照审查意见添加新提交。
say.note: Claude会创建新的提交，不会修改已有历史。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you create commits and pull requests following Arena's guidelines: forces DCO sign-off, uses <username>/<type>/<short-description> branch naming, prohibits AI attribution lines, adds new commits on review feedback instead of --amend, and defaults base branch to main.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit, stage changes, push the current branch, open a pull request, make a PR, submit changes, or mark work as ready to merge.

say_en.text: Commit and push these changes for me.
say_en.note: Claude will commit with DCO sign-off and push to origin.

say_en.text: Create a pull request against main.
say_en.note: Claude pushes the branch and opens a PR with proper formatting.

say_en.text: Add a new commit addressing the review feedback.
say_en.note: Claude creates a new commit instead of amending the previous one.
